name: voidwalking
description: Void-travel: walk off the RIM of a void-region (keyed by `flags.region_id`) — a cardinal step from a boundary tile into a coordinate that holds no tile at all, caught by the movement.edge hook — into a generated BRAID of transient waste rooms (shared trunk forking toward multiple regions, risk-for-loot detours, live enemy encounters) and cross it on foot. There is no entry verb: `voidwalk` only serves the muster overlay's `cancel`/`say` sub-commands. Rooms are synthetic (non-DB) zones via the transient-zone substrate; a party shares one instance (via follow); relog-safe through crossing_* player_flags.
